reviews.title: Cuts off
reviews.text: Cuts off. Stations just stop playing.

reviews.title: No longer works on iOS 12    :(
reviews.text:
Very sad.  This was my goto for streaming music on my trusty old iPod Touch 6.  Now just immediately crashes to home screen.  Nothing changed on this end, one day just started crashing. iOS 12.5.8

Tested on two other iPod Touch 6, same behavior.

Running latest version of RadioFM.

reviews.title: Created account but couldn’t sign in
reviews.text: It said email id didn’t exist

reviews.title: Can’t close ads
reviews.text: The app is nice. But too often shows ads that I Cannot close! This way I cannot proceed using the app. Never seen anything like this.

reviews.title: Excessive forced ads
reviews.text: Excessive Ads & pop-ups destroyed this app. Cannot minimize window preventing the listener from conducting simultaneous activities on other apps. Oh! Did I mention the ads are Excessive preventing music from playing.

reviews.title: Getting worse and worse!
reviews.text: Ads ruined this app. I get it, couple of time you get an ad, but now literally every single time you switch between apps and you want to get back to the same screen with the station info, you get an ad.

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: This radio app isn’t opening at all... Why?!!!

reviews.title: Advertising does NOT go away
reviews.text: I was led to believe that subscribing would allow avoiding these long advertisements. They DO NOT go away. They are embedded in the streams. I will not be renewing my subscription for $49!

reviews.title: Malware Advertisements?!
reviews.text:
Ad Messages saying, “We Have Noticed You Have # Of Trojans On Your iOS!”
“Something…” Shows An Image Of The iOS Gear Settings.

And Another Ad Message, “We Have Noticed That You Have Said Malware Within Your iOS Browser!”

I Would Advise You To,
Get Rid Of This App!
